import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_3.csv"
source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_4.csv"

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'year 2016']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'year 2014']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', '(Fall 2000)', ..., '(Fall 2014)']
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'year 2015']
df4 = pd.read_csv(source4_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']

# Rename columns in df0, df1, df3 to match target columns
# year 2014 -> persist 2014 (integer)
# year 2015 -> persist 2015 (integer)
# year 2016 -> persist 2016 (integer)
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={"year 2016": "persist 2016"})
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={"year 2014": "persist 2014"})
df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={"year 2015": "persist 2015"})

# The persist columns are integers in target, ensure integer type
df0_renamed["persist 2016"] = df0_renamed["persist 2016"].astype("Int64")
df1_renamed["persist 2014"] = df1_renamed["persist 2014"].astype("Int64")
df3_renamed["persist 2015"] = df3_renamed["persist 2015"].astype("Int64")

# From df2, select only the columns needed for target:
# Institution, (Fall 2011), (Fall 2012), (Fall 2013), (Fall 2014)
fall_cols = ['Institution', '(Fall 2011)', '(Fall 2012)', '(Fall 2013)', '(Fall 2014)']
df2_selected = df2[fall_cols].copy()

# Ensure fall columns are float type as in target
for col in fall_cols[1:]:
    df2_selected[col] = df2_selected[col].astype(float)

# From df4, we have Cohort 2014, Cohort 2015, Cohort 2016 as integers
df4_selected = df4.copy()
for col in ['Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']:
    df4_selected[col] = df4_selected[col].astype("Int64")

# Now join all dataframes on 'Institution'
# Start with df2_selected as it has the largest set of columns (fall years)
df_merge = df2_selected

# Join persist 2014 from df1_renamed
df_merge = df_merge.merge(df1_renamed[['Institution', 'persist 2014']], on='Institution', how='outer')

# Join persist 2015 from df3_renamed
df_merge = df_merge.merge(df3_renamed[['Institution', 'persist 2015']], on='Institution', how='outer')

# Join persist 2016 from df0_renamed
df_merge = df_merge.merge(df0_renamed[['Institution', 'persist 2016']], on='Institution', how='outer')

# Join Cohort columns from df4_selected
df_merge = df_merge.merge(df4_selected, on='Institution', how='outer')

# After merges, ensure all columns exist in the final dataframe
target_columns = ['Institution', '(Fall 2011)', '(Fall 2012)', '(Fall 2013)', '(Fall 2014)',
                  'persist 2014', 'persist 2015', 'persist 2016',
                  'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']

# Some institutions may be missing in some sources, fill missing numeric values with NaN or pd.NA
# For float columns (Fall years), fill missing with NaN (float)
for col in ['(Fall 2011)', '(Fall 2012)', '(Fall 2013)', '(Fall 2014)']:
    if col in df_merge.columns:
        df_merge[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge[col], errors='coerce')

# For integer columns, use nullable Int64 dtype and keep missing as <NA>
for col in ['persist 2014', 'persist 2015', 'persist 2016', 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']:
    if col in df_merge.columns:
        df_merge[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge[col], errors='coerce').astype("Int64")

# Reorder columns to target schema order
df_final = df_merge[target_columns]

# Sort by Institution alphabetically for neatness (optional)
df_final = df_final.sort_values(by='Institution').reset_index(drop=True)

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns in source1, source3, source0 to match persist columns in target
# persist 2014 from source1['year 2014']
# persist 2015 from source3['year 2015']
# persist 2016 from source0['year 2016']
source1 = source1.rename(columns={"year 2014": "persist 2014"})
source3 = source3.rename(columns={"year 2015": "persist 2015"})
source0 = source0.rename(columns={"year 2016": "persist 2016"})

# Rename columns in source4 to match target cohort columns (already matching)
# source4 columns: 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016' are already correct

# Join all tables on Institution (primary key)
df = source2.merge(source1, on="Institution", how="inner") \
            .merge(source3, on="Institution", how="inner") \
            .merge(source0, on="Institution", how="inner") \
            .merge(source4, on="Institution", how="inner")

# The target schema requires these columns:
# ['Institution': string, '(Fall 2011)': float, '(Fall 2012)': float, '(Fall 2013)': float, '(Fall 2014)': float,
#  'persist 2014': integer, 'persist 2015': integer, 'persist 2016': integer,
#  'Cohort 2014': integer, 'Cohort 2015': integer, 'Cohort 2016': integer]

# Select only needed columns from source2 (Fall 2011 to Fall 2014)
fall_cols = ['(Fall 2011)', '(Fall 2012)', '(Fall 2013)', '(Fall 2014)']

# Convert persist and cohort columns to integer (they may be float due to NaNs)
persist_cohort_cols = ['persist 2014', 'persist 2015', 'persist 2016', 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']

# Convert persist and cohort columns to integer safely (fill NaN with 0 before conversion)
df[persist_cohort_cols] = df[persist_cohort_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Group by Institution to ensure uniqueness and aggregate persist and cohort columns by sum
# (In case of duplicates, sum to match target unique keys)
df_grouped = df.groupby("Institution", as_index=False).agg(
    {
        '(Fall 2011)': 'first',
        '(Fall 2012)': 'first',
        '(Fall 2013)': 'first',
        '(Fall 2014)': 'first',
        'persist 2014': 'sum',
        'persist 2015': 'sum',
        'persist 2016': 'sum',
        'Cohort 2014': 'sum',
        'Cohort 2015': 'sum',
        'Cohort 2016': 'sum'
    }
)

# Write output to the specified file
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
